body:
## Summary

Functional coverage (`covergroup`/`coverpoint`/`cross`) and SystemVerilog assertions (`assert property`) are needed for verification completeness checking and formal sign-off.

## Key capabilities needed

### Covergroups
- [ ] `covergroup` declaration and `coverpoint` bindings
- [ ] `cross` coverage between coverpoints
- [ ] `bins` and `ignore_bins` specifications
- [ ] `$get_coverage()` / `get_coverage()` queries
- [ ] UVM coverage integration via `uvm_coverage_model_e`

### Assertions
- [ ] `assert property` with `@(posedge clk)` clocking
- [ ] `assume` and `cover` property directives
- [ ] Sequence operators: `##`, `|->`, `|=>`, `[*]`, `[->]`
- [ ] `$past()`, `$rose()`, `$fell()` sampled value functions

## Current state

iverilog has partial SystemVerilog assertion support but the VVP runtime coverage collection is not wired to UVM's coverage database.

## Prerequisites

- Phase 3 (virtual interface) needed for clocked assertions tied to DUT clock via VIF
title: Phase 5: Functional coverage and assertions (covergroup, assert)
